metadata.source: action order, returning 0 lets others try, driver refuses move/destruct of an action owner from a verb returning 0, flag 2 query_verb, nested command()
metadata.fluffos_fact: Actions are tried newest first and an action returning 0 passes on; moving or destructing an object that defines actions from a verb function that returns 0 is an error; all_inventory lists the newest arrival first; s[<1] raises on a multi-codepoint last character. s[i] on a letter with a combining mark silently gives the base letter; on an emoji sequence, flag or skin-tone emoji it raises an error; the slice s[i..i] gives the whole character in both cases.
